Fate — Innate Technique (1st level)

The wheel of fate is yours to steer and yours alone.

Beginning at 1st level, you can weave together threads of fate. As an action for 2 cursed energy, you bind two creatures within 30 ft of you with an invisible red thread for 1 minute. If a Fate requires Touch, you must touch both targets, but not necessarily at the same time. You choose a Fate, +1 Fate per 2 additional CE, up to your proficiency bonus that affects both while within 30 ft of each other:

Fate Effect Requirement
Bonds The targets gain a +2 bonus to AC. N/A
Promised Time? The creatures both have either advantage or disadvantage on attacks against each other. N/A
Mirrored If one target rolls a 20 or 1 on their turn, the other’s next roll will be the opposite. N/A
Magnetic If targets start their turn within 30 ft of each other, they are pulled 10 ft closer. If this brings them within 5 ft, they become tangled and prone (Str save to pull away). Touch
Shared Strengths Choose a damage resistance, immunity, vulnerability or condition immunity of a target. Both targets share that strength/weakness. 6th level
Linked Suffering When one of the linked targets takes damage, they take half as much damage and the linked creature takes the other half. 6th level, Touch
Destined Death The targets both have either advantage or disadvantage on saves against each other. 11th level, Touch

An effect that would damage the soul is capable of cutting your thread and removing your technique’s effects. Additionally, you cannot manipulate the fate of a creature that is completely lacking cursed energy (such as via Heavenly Restriction).
